scientific_integrity: Explicit infinite combinatorial proof and local Picard argument, supplemented by standalone finite verifications. Prior literature supplies the classical configuration; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Odd n at least five, characteristic p>n, and only residue classes q congruent to plus or minus one modulo n; no assertion for other Frobenius types or small characteristic. Standard normalization/group theory is used and historical priority is provisional.
title: Integral Frobenius tori and zeta functions of odd-degree Ceva divisors
